text:
alex: Heads up — after the firewall tightening in eu-west-1 this morning, new GPU nodes can't reach KMS during bootstrap. Provisioning failing with 403 KMSAccessDenied and keystore audit events not showing from that subnet. anyone oncall?

maria: i'm on it. seeing repeated errors in bootstrap logs: `error contacting KMS: Decrypt failed: AccessDenied`

engbot: deploy-canary failed for instance i-0abc123 — fallback to standby pool triggered (:warning:)

jordan: firewall change was the egress lockdown: deny 0.0.0.0/0 except to a handful of allowed CIDRs + 443. did we forget the privatelink endpoint IPs for keystore?

leah: looks like keystore privatelink lives in 10.20.5.0/24 and the rule only allows 10.0.0.0/16. so the endpoint IPs are not covered. :facepalm:

sam: short-term options: 1) open egress to kms.amazonaws.com for worker SG (fast) or 2) create missing VPC endpoint + route table update (safer, ~20-30m). which do we want?

maria: creating endpoint takes time. if we open egress temporarily we need security signoff. @security please advise.

security: prefer endpoint. if you open egress temporarily, add an expiration tag and a linked audit comment. we'll accept temporary exception for 1 hour max and require endpoint ticket to be created immediately.

alex: note cost impact: if we had to failover to another region's GPU pool, cross-region traffic + higher spot rates would be ~ $2.5k/day at sustained load. avoid if possible.

jordan: plan: 1) open outbound to kms.amazonaws.com on worker SG with strict port 443 and expiration tag 2) start privatelink endpoint create in parallel 3) verify node boot logs + keystore audit. i'll do step 1 now.

maria: updated SG to allow outbound to kms.amazonaws.com from workers (temporary). added tag `temp:expires=2026-03-20T15:30Z` and PR link in the change comment.

maria: nodes are rejoining. bootstrap logs show: `INFO: KMS decrypt succeeded, key id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01` — keystore acknowledges decrypt.

eng-sre: monitoring: GPU node registration spike during rejoin, autoscaler queued ~12 more warmup jobs but normalized within 6m. no sustained throttling.

leah: security — creating the endpoint ticket now: https://ticketing/REDWOOD-1823. also adding an alert to runbook: KMSAccessDenied during node_bootstrap -> pager to eng-platform oncall.

security: acknowledged. we'll review the SG change PR and confirm audit events. please attach CloudTrail snapshot and keystore audit after endpoint is live.

alex: good catch, everyone. assigning follow-ups: eng-platform to finish endpoint (jordan), security to review PR (security), eng-sre to watch autoscaler metrics for 24h (eng-sre), finance to estimate cost if we had to region-burst (sam).

alex: closing loop — nodes back to green in eu-west-1, no cross-region failover needed. leaving open until endpoint is created. :tada:
